messages:
elaine: heads-up — customer reported embeddings length changed after we applied a model lock this morning. their index rejects vectors now (expected 2048, receiving 1536). case #7321.

mike: can you paste the raw response + relevant headers? was the customer pinned to a specific variant at the time of failure?

elaine: pasted (sanitized):
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
x-model-id: embed-redwood-v2
x-model-variant: embed-redwood-v2-quant-8
Body: {"embedding": [0.012, ...]}
Measured len(embedding) = 1536

devon: thanks — I see the customer did pin to variant "embed-redwood-v2:locked-2024-03-04" during the rollout. Our canary produced a quantized variant where the projection head ended up truncated (so output dim changed).

mike: quick question — does this only happen for batched requests or also single-item requests?

elaine: repro steps I ran:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"embed-redwood-v2","input":["a","b"]}'
2) check lengths -> first embedding 2048, second embedding 1536
3) send single input -> embedding 2048
So it looks like batch parity mismatch.

devon: that suggests router is coalescing items from different backends/variants into the same batch (or switching variant mid-batch). I'm assigning to runtime team to check batching+routing logic. @mike can you pull traces for the case timeframe?

mike: grabbed trace id trace:0xabc123 from the customer's requests. Router logs show item 0 -> nodepool A (embed-redwood-v2-stable), item 1 -> nodepool B (embed-redwood-v2-quant-8) under burst policy. The batch was coalesced by the batching service but routed to different variant instances. Adding to incident.

sre-bot: Incident I-2024-678 created: embeddings dimension mismatch on batched requests after variant lock.

elaine: customer is asking for an ETA and a short-term workaround — reindexing their corpus is not feasible immediately. any mitigation we can offer?

devon: short-term options: 1) ask them to set client batch_size=1 (no coalescing), 2) advise to unpin the model to let requests go to the canonical latest variant (if they can), or 3) pin to the explicit variant id we confirm has 2048 output (we can provide the variant id). Long-term: fix router to preserve variant affinity for all items within a logical batch and enforce homogenous-batch routing for embeddings endpoints.

mike: I will prepare a hotfix to prevent cross-variant coalescing for embedding endpoints (disallow mixing variant ids in a single batch). rough ETA 2-4 hours for rollout to canary, then wider roll. will also produce a buildkite job to identify other pinned variants that may be affected.

elaine: told customer to use batch_size=1 for now or unpin to latest; they accepted temporary mitigation. noted in case.

devon: follow-up actions: created a small test harness that reproduces the swap and added a unit test; PR #4567 opened (runtime/router: prevent mixed-variant coalescing).

mike: will update incident I-2024-678 with RCA and timeline once hotfix is validated.

elaine: thanks all — closing loop with customer and will keep them posted.
